summary: The change solves the stated problem and the author confirmed the extra scope (rename, docs/ promotion, four skills). It is one architectural PR that mixes four decisions. A reviewer should read ADR-0011, ADR-0014, and ADR-0015 as the map, not the 390-file diff.

sensible.answer: Yes, against the author's stated problem. Design time is the missing moment. The author confirmed that the rename and the docs/ promotion belong in this same PR, so the extra surface is intended, not sneak-in. The problem belongs in this plugin: the interview, the bundle, and the viewer already live here.

maintainability.answer: Helps the long term: one organising rule (authored docs/, derived bundle), one ADR schema, four named skills. Hurts the review of this PR: scripts, skills, commands, viewer, and both fixtures move together. A later session can change one of those decisions only by reading three ADRs, which is the point of writing them.
maintainability.constraint_introduced: Authored source lives in docs/. Derived projections live in the bundle. Architecture modes refuse a foreign target. Design-time ADRs are decided until a human merge stamps approved_by.

pattern.answer: Design mode extends submit's intent capture earlier in time. The full-rebuild projection already exists for diagrams; ADRs and designs now follow it. That is a new pattern in this repo, and it earns its place because the lite JSON store no longer had a premise.

findings.claim: This PR ships four structural decisions in one merge. A reviewer who treats it as design-mode-only will miss the install-surface and storage changes.
findings.suggestion: Read the three decided ADRs first. Do not review the 390-file diff as one story.

findings.claim: ADR-0004 remains state approved and still says ste-writing stays off the install surface. ADR-0015 notes the clause is no longer current but does not reject ADR-0004.
findings.suggestion: On merge, add a history entry on ADR-0004 or mark the install-surface clause superseded so the register does not contradict itself.

boundary_checks.rule: Inner layers never import outer layers (HTTP, UI, DB drivers, framework code).
boundary_checks.evidence: This plugin has no domain package that must not import I/O. skills/ and scripts/ both read the filesystem by design.

boundary_checks.rule: Configuration crosses into code in one place, not scattered env reads.
boundary_checks.evidence: GEMINI_API_KEY still resolves from the hub cwd (ADR-0007). Design and submit do not add a second key lookup.

regret_risk: If this merges as one PR, the team inherits a plugin rename, a new authored-docs root, and a seventh mode at the same time. Six months later, a session that only wanted design mode cannot revert the rename without moving every bundle. The mitigation is already in the ADRs: they separate the three decisions. The remaining regret is operational — existing installs must follow the GitHub redirect, and leftover .prodyssey/ directories must migrate.
